questions.q: Which equation represents: "Four times the sum of a number x and a number y is equal to 25"?
questions.hint: "The sum of" means group with parentheses first.
questions.explanation: The sum is (x + y); four times it is 4(x + y).

questions.q: Which sentence describes the equation 2(x + 1) = 10?
options: The quantity two x plus one is equal to ten.
Two times the sum of x and one equals ten.
The quantity two times x plus one is the same as ten.
questions.hint: Read the parentheses as "the sum of".
questions.explanation: 2(x + 1) is two times the sum of x and one.

questions.q: The coldest temperature recorded in Alaska was about −80°F, which was 10°F warmer than the coldest in Siberia. Which equation finds the Siberian temperature T, and what is it?
questions.hint: Alaska is 10 degrees warmer, so add 10 to Siberia.

questions.q: Solve 4(x + 9) = 6x − 4.
questions.hint: Distribute first.

questions.q: Solve −(x − 1) = x + 1 for x.
questions.hint: Distribute the negative sign.

questions.q: Solve for h: A = ½bh.
questions.hint: Multiply both sides by 2, then divide by b.

questions.q: In 2015 Sarah spent $800 on lunches. In 2017 she spent $550. What was the rate of change from 2015 to 2017?
questions.hint: Rate of change = change in money ÷ change in years.

questions.q: What is the common difference of the arithmetic sequence 35, 32, 29, 26, …?
questions.hint: Subtract a term from the term after it.

questions.q: Find the inverse of the relation {(2, 3), (4, 5), (7, 10)}.
questions.hint: The inverse swaps x and y.
questions.explanation: Swap each pair: (2, 3) → (3, 2), and so on.

questions.q: Which function is nonlinear?
questions.hint: Linear functions have x only to the first power.
questions.explanation: y = x² + 1 has an x² term, so its graph is a parabola.

questions.q: Which equation has slope −2 and y-intercept 5?
questions.hint: Slope-intercept form is y = mx + b.

questions.q: Which equation represents a line through (8, 9) with slope 3?
questions.hint: Start with point-slope form y − y₁ = m(x − x₁).

questions.q: Which equation describes the line through (1, 2) and (3, 8)?
questions.hint: Find the slope, then the intercept.

questions.q: Which line is parallel to y = 4x − 1 and passes through (0, 3)?
questions.hint: Parallel lines have equal slopes.

questions.q: Which line is perpendicular to y = 2x + 5?
questions.hint: Perpendicular slopes are negative reciprocals.

questions.q: A gym charges AED 50 to join plus AED 20 per month. Which equation gives the total cost C after m months?
questions.hint: The joining fee is paid once; the monthly fee repeats.

questions.q: Solve the compound inequality 5x − 7 ≤ 13 or −4x + 3 > 11.
questions.hint: Solve each part separately, then take the union.
questions.explanation: x ≤ 4 or x < −2 combine to x ≤ 4.

questions.q: Solve −4x ≥ 20.
questions.hint: Dividing by a negative flips the sign.

questions.q: Solve −3 < 2x + 1 ≤ 9.
questions.hint: Do the same operation to all three parts.

questions.q: Solve |x − 2| < 5.
questions.hint: |x − a| < b means −b < x − a < b.

questions.q: A student has AED 60 and each lunch costs AED 7.50. Which inequality gives the number of lunches n they can buy?
questions.hint: Total spent cannot be more than the money available.
questions.explanation: Cost of n lunches is 7.5n and must be at most 60.
